notes: litert-community/LFM3-1.7B-LiteRT: LFM3-1.7B_mixed_int4_ekv2048.litertlm, a LiteRT-LM generic_model conversion of LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B at revision 40ebe0aa (LFM Open License v1.0): a hybrid decoder (13 short-convolution, 6 global-attention and 5 sliding-window layers), text in, text out; it thinks in a <think> block by default (enable_thinking switches it off); tool calls come back as XML text (no LiteRT-LM parser reads them).
